description: Generate accurate MLA 9th or 8th edition Works Cited entries and author-page in-text citations from structured source fields, a batch list (up to 500 sources), BibTeX or RIS. Supports websites, journal articles, books, book chapters, videos, newspapers, reports and podcasts; handles 1/2/3+ (et al.) authors, corporate authors, automatic MLA Title Case, authentic MLA month abbreviations, alphabetical sorting with three-hyphen (---.) repeated-author formatting, shortened-title disambiguation, and optional MLA-formatted Word (.docx) output with 0.5-inch hanging indents. 0 AI, deterministic, nothing stored. Free: 5 calls/day per IP. Paid: Radar API key (from €15/mo at https://radarbg.com/pricing#starter via X-API-Key) or $0.001/call via x402 at https://radarbg.com/x402/mla-citation-generator.
